comparison_rule: At each bond length, compare against the same-geometry 16 angstrom reference using the previous screen's AV03 energy and force tolerances, AV05/AV06 counts, and spatial L1 threshold. Both interpolation methods must pass if grids differ.
scope_limits: These two new internal fixtures and previous 0.74144 and 0.8 angstrom observations establish sampled-geometry checks, not a continuous interval guarantee.
Use one locked x86 CP2K PBE/GAPW/cc-pVDZ image. The 12 to 16 angstrom same-cutoff comparison diagnoses cell sensitivity at each boundary without claiming convergence of the finite reference.
The comparison informs selection of separate fixed H2 and He profiles for subsequent ARM and isolated OCI testing. It does not exercise an OCI or public runtime.
